purpose: Teach: 配給/ジャーナリズム/公衆/リアルタイム/真っ赤/隠す/断念/上る

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時の、本気で、絶対、配給、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled wartime distribution in your paper was really impressive.
lines.style: Warm appreciation in her voice. Slow, measured delivery. Genuine praise without performance. Slight pause before the compliment lands, as if she's choosing her words carefully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。戦後の、本気で、絶対、ジャーナリズム、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to examine postwar journalism as thoroughly as I could in the research.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, a little formal because she's the teacher. Careful, respectful tone. Slight nervousness in the pacing—wanting to acknowledge the compliment without overstating it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、公衆、絶対、衛生、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And your perspective on prewar public health was remarkably broad. Really thoughtful work.
lines.style: Genuine reflection in her voice. Slower pace, almost meditative. She's noticing details in his work that matter to her. Warm but not effusive—teacher-like in the best way.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。報道の、本気で、絶対、リアルタイム、絶対、化、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I was especially interested in how real-time reporting shaped the historical narrative.
lines.style: Focused, measured response. He's following her lead into the substance. Respectful but engaged—not just deferring, but genuinely interested in the conversation they're having.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、真っ赤、絶対、な、絶対、夕焼け、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you traced that through the wartime imagery—the loss, the erasure—was striking.
lines.style: Slower, more intimate delivery. She's moved by something in his work. Pause before 'striking.' Her voice carries both admiration and a kind of sadness about what the paper explored.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史を、本気で、絶対、隠す、絶対、行為、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to show how history itself can become a site of erasure, not just memory.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. He's articulating something that matters. Steady pace, clear-eyed. Not rushed—he's trusting the substance of what he's saying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、断念、絶対、された、絶対、計画、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: That understanding of what was abandoned, what was lost—it deepened the whole argument.
lines.style: Warm, reflective close. She's pulling the threads together. Gentle pacing, genuine admiration. This is a teacher noticing when a student has done something real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史で、本気で、絶対、犠牲者数が、絶対、上る、絶対、事象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. Those moments in the archive where the evidence just stops—that's what I wanted to illuminate.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. He's present in this moment of recognition. Respectful but honest—not deferring anymore, but standing behind his work. Slight vulnerability in the openness.
